missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Шофёр' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Наш' shows possession, and 'опытный' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Шофёра' takes the genitive form for the animate masculine accusative object of 'ждём'. 'Нашего' agrees in the same case.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Шофёра' is the genitive after 'у', the owner of the car. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Шофёру' is the dative recipient of 'дал'. 'Документы' is the accusative object being handed over.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Шофёром' is the instrumental after 'с', naming who I sit beside. 'Рядом' reinforces the closeness.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О шофёре' uses the prepositional form 'шофёре' after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Автобуса' is a genitive modifier.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with object. 'Шофёр' is the nominative subject of 'включил', while 'фары' is the accusative object. 'Быстро' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Шофёры' is the nominative plural subject of 'водят'. 'Опытные' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'аккуратно' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Шофёров' takes the genitive plural form for the animate accusative object of 'наняла'. 'Новых' agrees in the same case.
Strategic focus: Dative plural object. 'Шофёрам' is the dative plural required by 'доверяют', the ones trusted. 'Опытным' agrees in the dative plural.
